items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued November 13 at 4:01PM EST until November 14 at 11:00AM EST by NWS Melbourne FL
items.description:
* WHAT...Northwest winds around 20 knots with gusts up to 30 knots
and seas 4 to 6 feet, up to 7 feet in the Gulf Stream north of
Cape Canaveral expected.

* WHERE...Portions of Atlantic coastal waters.

* WHEN...From 7 PM this evening to 11 AM EST Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
